title: DC-area forecast: 80s are back through Wednesday, but a weekend chill looms
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Beautiful sunshine as temperatures climb through the 70s this morning, heading for highs in the low 80s this afternoon.

What’s next? Sunshine rules Wednesday, too, as temperatures approach record highs. We turn a bit cooler and cloudier Thursday, with showers becoming more likely Friday ahead of a windy, chilly weekend.

Today’s daily digit — 8/10: 80 degrees won't be a hit with the pumpkin spice latte crowd, but this sunny day with comfortable humidity is still plenty nice! | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Tuesday): A beautifully sunny morning as temperatures climb through the 60s and into the 70s, with light winds mainly from the south. Sunshine continues this afternoon as highs reach the low to mid-80s. Confidence: High 😎 Nice Day!

Tonight: Mostly clear and comfortable, with lows ranging through the 60s. Light breezes are mainly from the southwest. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Wednesday): Bright sunshine and unseasonably warm, with humidity climbing to more uncomfortable levels. Highs in the mid- to upper 80s, combined with dew points in the mid- to upper 60s, make it feel closer to 90 or even the low 90s at times. Light winds continue from the southwest. Record highs dating to 1975 may be broken at area airports (87 in DC and 86 at Dulles and BWI Marshall). Confidence: High

Tomorrow night: Becoming partly to mostly cloudy with a chance of a light shower. Lows stay on the warm side, in the low to mid-60s, with light winds. Confidence: Medium-High

A look ahead

Thursday features a mix of clouds and sun, with a chance of showers. Cooler highs in the low to mid-70s are still a bit warmer than normal. Thursday night is mostly cloudy with a chance of scattered showers as lows dip into the upper 50s and low 60s. Confidence: Medium

Friday brings back some warmth ahead of a powerful cold front, with partly sunny skies and highs in the upper 70s to near 80. Showers are possible during the day, with an increasing chance of showers and thunderstorms as the front passes Friday evening. Temperatures then drop sharply Friday night, with blustery conditions and lows in the 40s. Confidence: Medium

This weekend delivers the coolest weather so far this season. Saturday is sunny but windy, with highs in the 50s. Sunday is also quite cool, with highs in the 50s to near 60, but less wind than Saturday. Saturday night should be mostly clear and cold, with lows in the mid-30s to low 40s. Watch out for patchy frost in the suburbs and exurbs. Confidence: Medium

Next week starts sunny and dry, with near-normal highs in the upper 60s. Another round of warmer 70s arrives by the second half of the week, while rain chances hold off until the weekend.

DC weather history for October 13

A powerful 1893 hurricane swept through with flooding rains and damaging winds, while in 1983 severe storms spawned a tornado that caused significant damage in Northern Virginia.
